findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice mcqs for Chapter 11 in the same format as Chapter 1 (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 81 questions numbered 1-81; by section: 11.1 9, 11.2 8, 11.3 38, 11.4 9, 11.5 17. Keys: {'a': 21, 'b': 20, 'c': 20, 'd': 20}.

Covers sections 11.1-11.5 in order (relative motion, frames of reference, the postulates and their results: time dilation, length contraction, mass variation, relativity of simultaneity; mass-energy equivalence; space-time). Numericals use values changed from the book's examples and exercise and were recomputed in Python; constants the chapter does not give are stated in the question. Book corrections followed: no material object moves at the speed of light; the bending of light by gravity belongs to the general theory of relativity.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
